Shah Rukh Khan inaugurates cricket stadium in Los Angeles

Actor Shah Rukh Khan has announced the inauguration of the LA Knight Riders Cricket Ground in Pomona, California. He described the opening as a "dream" come true and expressed gratitude to ICC Chairman Jay Shah and CEO Sanjog Gupta for their support. The stadium is slated to host Major League Cricket matches and is anticipated to be a venue for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.
